title: Cofinal κ-directed poset replacement for a small filtered quasicategory
statement:
Use universes $\mathcal U\in\mathcal U'$, $\kappa$-small simplicial sets and $\kappa$-filtered quasicategories from [def-coef-presentable-infinity-category], and nerves, coherent functors and colimits from [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones]. Let $\kappa\in\mathcal U$ be an infinite regular cardinal and let $I$ be a $\mathcal U$-small $\kappa$-filtered quasicategory. There exist a $\mathcal U$-small partially ordered set $A$ and a coherent functor $u:N(A)\to I$ with the following properties. Every subset of $A$ of cardinality less than $\kappa$ has an upper bound, including the empty subset, so $A$ is nonempty. The functor $u$ is cofinal: for every coherent diagram $F:I\to\mathcal C$ in a quasicategory $\mathcal C$ admitting small colimits, restriction of a colimiting cocone along $u$ is colimiting. Equivalently the induced comparison
$$\operatorname{colim}_{a\in N(A)}F(u(a))\longrightarrow\operatorname{colim}_{i\in I}F(i)$$
is an equivalence, natural in $F$ and respecting the restricted cocone legs.
